The 2028 US Presidential Election is scheduled to take place on November 7, 2028.

This market will resolve to the person who wins the 2028 US Presidential Election.

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race for the same candidate by the inauguration date (January 20, 2029) this market will resolve based on who is inaugurated.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus for the 2028 presidential election winner assigns the highest implied probability to JD Vance, followed by a fragmented field of Democratic options such as Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and Jon Ossoff, reflecting the open primary contests on both sides after the prior cycle. Key differentiators among leading contenders include incumbency or vice-presidential positioning, fundraising scale, appeal to swing-state voters, and primary performance metrics that shape paths to electoral votes. Consolidation behind one outcome could accelerate via early primary or caucus results, party leader endorsements, national polling trends, or shifts in turnout patterns among key voting blocs. Midterm outcomes and candidate announcements remain scheduled catalysts that traders monitor for changes in viability assessments.
